Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Have had it for 3 weeks. Assembled it myself in order to get one of the color options.  Assembly instructions were excellent and took about a half hour to assemble. Used the grill about 4 times. Steaks and burgers came out great.
Results.Title: Excellent assembly instructions

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the first grill I have purchased and couldn't be happier. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: Everything I expected and more

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Great grilling for the money, side tables are a little flimsy and the right side is slightly crooked. Thinner metal on the side tables than the old Weber I was used to. No cover included, had to spend about $80 on a cover that is thin and not as nice as the old style Weber used to make. 
Seems like it will hold up for a long time regardless. Would have liked to see stainless grates included for the grilling surface. Nice temperature control and flare-ups are controlled well. Tank fuel gauge is a must for any grill, it is nice that it is included versus other brands.
Results.Title: Good for the price, great performance!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
First, the grill was very easy to put together. Unfortunately, I had an incorrect part in the box, the one bottom rubber leg piece, but I contacted Weber and I had my replacement part within days. That piece did not effect the grill itself so it really wasn't a big deal. I only mention it because of the very expeditious customer service.
As for the grill, we have used it at leas three times a week since we got it. It is the perfect size for our screened in porch. The grill is very sturdy and it evenly heats. Yesterday I made a beer can chicken on it and it was very evenly cooked; it may have been the best chicken on a grill yet. 
I would definitely recommend this grill to others.
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought this to replace an old grill master. Slightly smaller but works great. Heat is a little uneven especially near the edges(cooler). Disappointed couldn't get a side burner for it. All in all good quality grill so far.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought the grill to replace an older one. This grill exceed my expectations.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bough this grill about a month ago when my old grill (not a Weber) finally gave up, and I am so happy I did! I love how easy it is even for a novice griller to use, and how easy it is to keep clean. I used the timing information to cook a London broil and it was the best one I ever made. I never knew about indirect heat for cooking meat and it turned out a perfectly cooked London broil! Love this grill!
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

I've had my Spirit II E-310 for about a month, and it has been great! Quality construction, very heavy, and cooks evenly with no cold spots. Anyone looking for a quality grill should look no further than Weber. Don't buy a cheaper one; you get what you pay for.

The tank meter, in my opinion, is not very accurate and I would just get rid of it as most propane tanks come with a built-in meter. I have iGrill3 ready feature, but again that's too fancy for me and I use a regular instant thermometer.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought the Spirit II E-310 a little over a month ago and have used it almost every night since. I love the excellent range of temperature I'm able to achieve with this grill, open or closed. If I want to sear a NY Strip, I just crank all three burners to high and in 10 minutes I'm looking at a lid temperature of around 600°, closer to 700° at the grates! If I want to go low and slow for some bone in chicken, I turn two burners on medium and cook over the unlit side. Overall very happy with my purchase!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd Weber grill.  I have always enjoyed this product and my grills all lasted 10 plus years.  I would rate the cooking components of the grill as excellent, as it delivers a quality cookout every time!  However, I am disappointed in the construction of the grill base, for lack of a better term.  I truly miss the fact that the grill no longer comes with a closed lower portion, for storing and keeping things dry and out of sight.  In addition, my last 2 grills were equipped with 4 wheels, and wheels that locked in place.  I find it very difficult to move the grill around the deck with just the 2 wheels., it is heavy, cumbersome, and very tough to maneuver.  I wish I would have paid more attention to those features, as it has put a damper on my grilling experience.  I am not sure how much those 2 features would have added to the cost of this grill, but in my estimation, they would have been worth every penny.
Results.Title: Cooking Quality Excellent, Cart Quality Poor
